# ---- ManifestCost: assy-code combo option source (lookups/assyCode) ----
	# CODE-STRING combo (NOT surrogate-FK): value == label == VC_ASSY_PART_NUMBER_CODE.
	# Sourced from DISTINCT INV_FORECAST_DETAIL_INF (the legacy SelectSingleField source).
	# Stores the string, never an id. Prepends a blank item (legacy prepends ' ').
	# IG81-COMPAT: plain runPrepQuery; identical on 8.1.52 and 8.3.
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	sql = ("SELECT DISTINCT VC_ASSY_PART_NUMBER_CODE AS id, VC_ASSY_PART_NUMBER_CODE AS label "
	       "FROM INV_FORECAST_DETAIL_INF WHERE VC_ASSY_PART_NUMBER_CODE <> '' "
	       "-- IG-SITE: AND site_id = ? "
	       "ORDER BY VC_ASSY_PART_NUMBER_CODE")
	ds = system.db.runPrepQuery(sql, [], DB)
	opts = [{"value": "", "label": ""}]
	for r in xrange(ds.rowCount):
		code = ds.getValueAt(r, "id")
		opts.append({"value": code, "label": code})
	log.info("SPIKE ManifestCost/assyCode lookup: %d assy codes" % ds.rowCount)
	return opts

# ---- Master/ManifestCost combined grid builder — inline runPrepQuery (Order-spike pattern) ----
	# Executes the canonical ManifestCost/list SQL from master-crud-namedqueries.sql via
	# system.db.runPrepQuery. IG81-COMPAT: plain parameterized T-SQL; runs identically on 8.1.52 and 8.3.
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	parts = unicode(value).split("|")
	searchTerm = parts[0]
	siteId = int(float(parts[1]))   # IG-SITE: plumbed through view->query; predicate still commented (D1)

	sql = ("SELECT  IN_MANIFEST_COST_ID      AS RecordID, "
	       "        VC_ASSY_PART_NUMBER_CODE AS AssyCode, "
	       "        VC_ASSY_MANIFEST_NUMBER  AS ManifestNo, "
	       "        VC_START_MANIFEST        AS StartManifest, "
	       "        VC_END_MANIFEST          AS EndManifest, "
	       "        MO_PRICE                 AS Price "
	       "FROM    INV_MANIFEST_COST_MST "
	       "WHERE  (? = '' OR VC_ASSY_PART_NUMBER_CODE LIKE '%' + ? + '%' OR VC_ASSY_MANIFEST_NUMBER LIKE '%' + ? + '%') "
	       "-- IG-SITE:  AND site_id = ? "
	       "ORDER BY VC_ASSY_PART_NUMBER_CODE")
	ds = system.db.runPrepQuery(sql, [searchTerm, searchTerm, searchTerm], DB)
	log.info("SPIKE ManifestCost/list: %d rows (search='%s' site=%d)" % (ds.rowCount, searchTerm, siteId))

	columns = [
		{"field": "AssyCode",      "header": {"title": "Assy Code"}, "strictWidth": 140, "sort": "ascending"},
		{"field": "ManifestNo",    "header": {"title": "Manifest #"}, "strictWidth": 90},
		{"field": "StartManifest", "header": {"title": "Start"}, "strictWidth": 100},
		{"field": "EndManifest",   "header": {"title": "End"},   "strictWidth": 100},
		{"field": "Price",         "header": {"title": "Price"}, "strictWidth": 110},
		{"field": "RecordID",      "header": {"title": "id"}, "visible": False}
	]
	rows = []
	for r in xrange(ds.rowCount):
		price = ds.getValueAt(r, "Price")
		rows.append({
			"RecordID":      ds.getValueAt(r, "RecordID"),
			"AssyCode":      ds.getValueAt(r, "AssyCode"),
			"ManifestNo":    ds.getValueAt(r, "ManifestNo"),
			"StartManifest": ds.getValueAt(r, "StartManifest"),
			"EndManifest":   ds.getValueAt(r, "EndManifest"),
			"Price":         float(price) if price is not None else None
		})
	return {"data": rows, "columns": columns}

onChange.script:
# ---- ManifestCost combined view: recordId change -> load detail ----
	# The grid onRowClick sets self.view.custom.recordId = event.value["RecordID"] (a
	# same-view prop write, NO navigation). This onChange fires on that write and populates
	# the in-view form. recordId==0 -> insert mode. RecordID is IN_MANIFEST_COST_ID (D2).
	# IG81-COMPAT: plain change script + T-SQL, identical on 8.1.52 and 8.3.
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	v = self.view if hasattr(self, "view") else self
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	c = v.custom
	cv = getattr(currentValue, "value", currentValue)
	recId = int(cv or 0)
	log.info("SPIKE ManifestCost Detail recordId onChange fired: recId=%s origin=%s" % (recId, origin))

	if recId <= 0:
		c.statusMsg = "New manifest cost — enter details and Save."
		log.info("SPIKE ManifestCost Detail: insert mode (recordId=0)")
		return

	getSql = ("SELECT IN_MANIFEST_COST_ID, VC_ASSY_PART_NUMBER_CODE, VC_ASSY_MANIFEST_NUMBER, "
	          "VC_START_MANIFEST, VC_END_MANIFEST, MO_PRICE "
	          "FROM INV_MANIFEST_COST_MST WHERE IN_MANIFEST_COST_ID = ? -- IG-SITE: AND site_id = ?")
	ds = system.db.runPrepQuery(getSql, [recId], DB)
	if ds.rowCount == 0:
		c.statusMsg = "Manifest cost id %d not found." % recId
		log.warn("SPIKE ManifestCost Detail: id %d not found" % recId); return
	def g(col):
		val = ds.getValueAt(0, col)
		return val if val is not None else ""
	c.form_assyCode = g("VC_ASSY_PART_NUMBER_CODE")
	c.form_manifestNo = g("VC_ASSY_MANIFEST_NUMBER")
	c.form_start = g("VC_START_MANIFEST")
	c.form_end = g("VC_END_MANIFEST")
	price = ds.getValueAt(0, "MO_PRICE")
	c.form_price = float(price) if price is not None else 0
	c.statusMsg = "Editing %s (id %d)." % (c.form_assyCode, recId)
	log.info("SPIKE ManifestCost Detail loaded id=%d code=%s manifest=%s start=%s end=%s price=%s"
	         % (recId, c.form_assyCode, c.form_manifestNo, c.form_start, c.form_end, c.form_price))

config.script:
# Re-run ManifestCost/list. Bumping runNonce changes the gridModel expression input.
	self.view.custom.runNonce = (self.view.custom.runNonce or 0) + 1
	system.util.getLogger("SPIKE").info("ManifestCost search -> runNonce=" + str(self.view.custom.runNonce))

# New record: same-view prop write (NO navigation). Setting recordId=0 fires the
	# custom.recordId onChange -> insert-mode. Clear the form so a stale edit doesn't linger.
	c = self.view.custom
	c.form_assyCode = ""; c.form_manifestNo = " "; c.form_start = ""; c.form_end = ""; c.form_price = 0
	c.recordId = 0
	c.statusMsg = "New manifest cost — enter details and Save."
	system.util.getLogger("SPIKE").info("SPIKE ManifestCost New -> recordId=0 (insert mode)")

# Row select -> SAME-VIEW prop write (single-view decision; NO navigation).
	# event.value is the row data in IA 8.1. Set custom.recordId, which fires the
	# custom.recordId onChange load script (D2: RecordID is IN_MANIFEST_COST_ID, never the code).
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	try:
		recId = event.value["RecordID"]
	except Exception:
		recId = event.value["RecordID"] if hasattr(event, "value") else None
	if recId is None:
		log.warn("SPIKE ManifestCost list row click: no RecordID in event")
		return
	log.info("SPIKE ManifestCost list -> open Detail recordId=%s" % recId)
	self.view.custom.recordId = int(recId)

props.text: Click a row to edit in the panel at right. Server-side LIKE search on assy code + manifest #. Single combined view — row-select is an in-view prop write, no navigation. D13.2(b): the legacy manifest-number unique index was DROPPED; the real rule is D6 non-overlapping date windows per assy code. Site param plumbed; IG-SITE predicate commented (Postgres phase).

config.script:
# ---- ManifestCost Save (insert-or-update) ----
	# recordId==0 -> insert; >0 -> update. Validation order (D6 / D13.2 b):
	#   presence(assy code, start, end) -> start<=end -> price>=0 -> checkWindowOverlap.
	# NO manifest-number uniqueness check (D13.2 b: that legacy quirk's unique index was
	# DROPPED as the D13.3 conversion step, so there is no DB backstop either). On success:
	# flip recordId to the saved id (edit mode) + refresh grid via runNonce (same-view).
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	c = self.view.custom
	# ---- SERVER-SIDE WRITE GATE (M4 P15 sweep — the H3 hole-closer) ----
	# auth.requireWrite resolves the caller's roles FROM THE SESSION (gateway-side, NOT a client
	# prop) and authorizes ProductionControl|Admin, raising AuthError on deny — BEFORE any
	# system.db write. A forged client prop or an anonymous session is rejected HERE, not by the
	# UI. This closes the reintroduced legacy H3 hole (the write was previously authorized client-
	# side only). Same gate the Sites Save/Delete/New carry (gen_sites_view.py rule #1).
	import auth as A
	try:
		A.requireWrite(self.session)
	except A.AuthError, e:
		c.statusMsg = "DENIED (server-side): " + unicode(e)
		system.util.getLogger("SPIKE").warn("SPIKE ManifestCost Save DENIED (server-side gate): " + unicode(e)); return
	recId = int(c.recordId or 0)
	siteId = int(c.siteId or 1)   # IG-SITE: plumbed; predicate commented (D1)

	code = (c.form_assyCode or "").strip().upper()   # legacy combo is uppercase
	manifestNo = (c.form_manifestNo or "").strip()
	start = (c.form_start or "").strip()
	end = (c.form_end or "").strip()

	# ---- presence (assy code, start, end) ----
	if code == "":
		c.statusMsg = "Assy code is required."
		log.info("SPIKE ManifestCost save REJECTED: blank assy code"); return
	if start == "":
		c.statusMsg = "Start manifest (yyyymmdd) is required."
		log.info("SPIKE ManifestCost save REJECTED: blank start"); return
	if end == "":
		c.statusMsg = "End manifest (yyyymmdd) is required."
		log.info("SPIKE ManifestCost save REJECTED: blank end"); return

	# ---- start <= end (D6; string compare valid for yyyymmdd) ----
	if start > end:
		c.statusMsg = "Start manifest must be on or before end manifest."
		log.info("SPIKE ManifestCost save REJECTED: start>end (%s>%s)" % (start, end)); return

	# ---- price >= 0 (§8.7 ≥0 half; zero allowed) ----
	def toMoney(v):
		try:
			return float(v) if v not in (None, "") else 0.0
		except Exception:
			return None
	price = toMoney(c.form_price)
	if price is None:
		c.statusMsg = "Price must be a number."
		log.info("SPIKE ManifestCost save REJECTED: non-numeric price"); return
	if price < 0:
		c.statusMsg = "Price must be zero or greater."
		log.info("SPIKE ManifestCost save REJECTED: negative price=%s" % price); return

	# ---- D6 checkWindowOverlap (the headline rule; NOT manifest-number uniqueness) ----
	excludeId = recId if recId > 0 else 0
	ovSql = ("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM INV_MANIFEST_COST_MST "
	         "WHERE VC_ASSY_PART_NUMBER_CODE = ? AND IN_MANIFEST_COST_ID <> ? "
	         "AND NOT (? < VC_START_MANIFEST OR ? > VC_END_MANIFEST) "
	         "-- IG-SITE: AND site_id = ?")
	ov = system.db.runPrepQuery(ovSql, [code, excludeId, end, start], DB)
	if ov.rowCount > 0 and int(ov.getValueAt(0, 0)) > 0:
		c.statusMsg = ("Window %s–%s overlaps an existing price window for assy %s. "
		               "Adjust the dates so windows don't overlap.") % (start, end, code)
		log.info("SPIKE ManifestCost save REJECTED: window overlap code=%s %s-%s" % (code, start, end)); return

	# 16-char yyyymmddHHMMSSff audit recipe (matches Size/legacy; same value to both on insert)
	audit = ("CONVERT(char(8),GETDATE(),112) "
	         "+ SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),1,2) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),4,2) "
	         "+ SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),7,2) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),10,2)")

	try:
		if recId == 0:
			# legacy positional INSERT wrote @AddDate to BOTH VC_LAST_UPDATE and VC_ADD (parity)
			insSql = ("INSERT INTO INV_MANIFEST_COST_MST "
			          "(VC_ASSY_PART_NUMBER_CODE, VC_ASSY_MANIFEST_NUMBER, VC_START_MANIFEST, "
			          " VC_END_MANIFEST, MO_PRICE, VC_LAST_UPDATE, VC_ADD) "
			          "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?, " + audit + ", " + audit + "); "
			          "SELECT CAST(SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS int) AS newId")
			rs = system.db.runPrepQuery(insSql, [code, manifestNo, start, end, price], DB)
			newId = int(rs.getValueAt(0, 0))
			c.statusMsg = "Inserted manifest cost %s (id %d)." % (code, newId)
			log.info("SPIKE ManifestCost INSERT ok: code=%s manifest=%s %s-%s price=%s newId=%d"
			         % (code, manifestNo, start, end, price, newId))
			c.runNonce = (c.runNonce or 0) + 1   # refresh grid (same-view)
			c.recordId = newId                    # flip to edit mode -> fires onChange reload
		else:
			updSql = ("UPDATE INV_MANIFEST_COST_MST SET VC_ASSY_PART_NUMBER_CODE=?, "
			          "VC_ASSY_MANIFEST_NUMBER=?, VC_START_MANIFEST=?, VC_END_MANIFEST=?, MO_PRICE=?, "
			          "VC_LAST_UPDATE = " + audit + " "
			          "WHERE IN_MANIFEST_COST_ID = ? -- IG-SITE: AND site_id = ?")
			n = system.db.runPrepUpdate(updSql, [code, manifestNo, start, end, price, recId], DB)
			c.statusMsg = "Updated manifest cost %s (%d row)." % (code, n)
			log.info("SPIKE ManifestCost UPDATE ok: id=%d code=%s rows=%d" % (recId, code, n))
			c.runNonce = (c.runNonce or 0) + 1   # refresh grid (same-view)
	except Exception, e:
		c.statusMsg = "Save failed: %s" % unicode(e)
		log.warn("SPIKE ManifestCost save FAILED: %s" % unicode(e))

# ---- ManifestCost Delete — SIMPLE HARD DELETE (no gate) ----
	# This master has NO trigger and NO stored FK children: prices are JOINed live by the
	# invoice/EDI810 procs at report time on the assy code, with no stored child row to
	# orphan. So delete is a plain hard delete by IN_MANIFEST_COST_ID (faithful to the
	# legacy DELETE_ManifestCost, which had no in-use check). No refCount.
	# [Future flag only: archive a price with billing history rather than delete — not built.]
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	c = self.view.custom
	# ---- SERVER-SIDE WRITE GATE (M4 P15 sweep — the H3 hole-closer) ----
	# auth.requireWrite resolves the caller's roles FROM THE SESSION (gateway-side, NOT a client
	# prop) and authorizes ProductionControl|Admin, raising AuthError on deny — BEFORE any
	# system.db write. A forged client prop or an anonymous session is rejected HERE, not by the
	# UI. This closes the reintroduced legacy H3 hole (the write was previously authorized client-
	# side only). Same gate the Sites Save/Delete/New carry (gen_sites_view.py rule #1).
	import auth as A
	try:
		A.requireWrite(self.session)
	except A.AuthError, e:
		c.statusMsg = "DENIED (server-side): " + unicode(e)
		system.util.getLogger("SPIKE").warn("SPIKE ManifestCost Delete DENIED (server-side gate): " + unicode(e)); return
	recId = int(c.recordId or 0)
	code = (c.form_assyCode or "").strip()
	if recId == 0:
		c.statusMsg = "Nothing to delete (unsaved new record)."
		return
	try:
		delN = system.db.runPrepUpdate("DELETE FROM INV_MANIFEST_COST_MST WHERE IN_MANIFEST_COST_ID = ? -- IG-SITE: AND site_id = ?", [recId], DB)
		log.info("SPIKE ManifestCost DELETE ok: id=%d code=%s rows=%d" % (recId, code, delN))
		c.statusMsg = "Deleted manifest cost %s." % code
		c.form_assyCode = ""; c.form_manifestNo = " "; c.form_start = ""; c.form_end = ""; c.form_price = 0
		c.runNonce = (c.runNonce or 0) + 1   # refresh grid (same-view)
		c.recordId = 0                        # back to insert mode
	except Exception, e:
		c.statusMsg = "Delete failed: %s" % unicode(e)
		log.warn("SPIKE ManifestCost DELETE FAILED: %s" % unicode(e))

# Clear -> reset to a blank insert-mode form (recordId=0). Same-view, no navigation.
	c = self.view.custom
	c.form_assyCode = ""; c.form_manifestNo = " "; c.form_start = ""; c.form_end = ""; c.form_price = 0
	c.recordId = 0
	c.statusMsg = "Cleared — ready for a new manifest cost."
	system.util.getLogger("SPIKE").info("SPIKE ManifestCost form cleared")
